Reconstructed the deterministic toggle matching including empty, with pivot order 12,10,5,7,2,4,11,6,9,3,0,8,1, 579 pairs, 13 unmatched positive-dimensional critical faces (six 2-cells/seven 3-cells), and verified a global DAG on all 1171 faces/4693 incidences. The exact signed critical Morse boundary is a 6×7 matrix with Smith diagonal 1,1,1,1,2,0; independent calculation reproduced every entry and its invariant factors. The basepoint CW model has no 1-cells, so π2≅H2 for its 2-skeleton; integer changes of bases correspond to 2-sphere wedge equivalences and 3-cell slides. Four unit attachments cancel, one degree-two attachment forms M(Z/2,2), one free 2-cell gives S², two zero attaching 3-cells give 2S³. Thus H~2=Z⊕Z/2, H~3=Z², all other reduced groups vanish; pure dimension six and torsion imply non-shellability.
